purpose: Freeze one non-overlapping raw-source candidate: the published taroz/gsdc2023 base-station pseudorange compensation path.

moving_mean.selection: exact source dt equality: 1.0 s -> 151, 15.0 s -> 11

source_contract.matching: same satellite and same frequency before residual correction; no cross-frequency or cross-satellite fill
source_contract.base_residual: source modeled base pseudorange residual after satellite geometry/clock modeling at the fixed base coordinate
source_contract.interpolation: linear interpolation of the smoothed base residual at each rover observation time; no extrapolation, endpoint hold, or nearest-time fill
source_contract.sign: the correction is subtracted: P_rover_corrected = P_rover - pc_f(t_rover); this is the source operation obsr.(f).resPc = obsr.(f).resPc-pc
source_contract.units: pseudorange and residual correction in metres; timestamps in the source observation time contract

allowed_inputs.rover: raw Android device_gnss.csv only for the later separately authorized audit/implementation
allowed_inputs.base: raw base-station RINEX observation member only, subject to the preflight below
allowed_inputs.navigation: the route's already-declared broadcast navigation only in a later separately authorized stage
allowed_inputs.base_coordinate: finite published base-station coordinate or finite RINEX header APPROX POSITION XYZ; its provenance must be recorded
forbidden: MAT/MATLAB data products including phone_data.mat or gt.mat
base_position.csv or base_offset.csv as an unpinned/precomputed substitute
handset ground truth, WLS/SvPosition/SvElevation, precomputed inference coordinates
solver or trajectory rerun during this source-only phase

required_before_any_raw_audit: one exact, hash-pinned base RINEX member per route
RINEX header or independently published station coordinate is finite and station provenance is explicit
base epochs have valid source time and overlap the rover time domain
the member is a surveyed/reference base station, not handset truth or a derived coordinate
base_input_preflight.fail_closed: if any route lacks a verified base RINEX, coordinate, time overlap, or station role, do not read a substitute and do not implement/score this candidate

fixed_future_gates.same_satellite_frequency_match: all correction keys must retain original satellite+frequency identity; duplicates and cross-key fills are zero
fixed_future_gates.raw_only_materiality: median absolute pc >= 0.10 m and p95 absolute pc >= 0.30 m on every route
fixed_future_gates.raw_only_closure_effect: a predeclared same-satellite code-rate/adjacent innovation statistic must improve by >=5% on every route, with no route worsening >5%; this is diagnostic only and uses no truth
fixed_future_gates.loo_stability: the fixed source formula has no fitted parameter; three-route leave-one-route-out audit must preserve correction direction and the materiality/closure decision on the held route
fixed_future_gates.sign_check: synthetic positive-pc fixture must reduce the rover modeled residual by subtraction; opposite sign fails closed
fixed_future_gates.integrity: raw input hashes/bytes, monotonic timestamps, duplicate keys, finite fields, read count, and artifact hashes are sealed before any result

non_overlap_and_scope.phase43: preserved no-base native champion; no comparison or rerun in this freeze
non_overlap_and_scope.phase51: not combined with the Android SV-time sigma-floor experiment
non_overlap_and_scope.phase58: not combined with the Cn0 Doppler sigma experiment
non_overlap_and_scope.phase61: not combined with Cn0 pseudorange residual calibration
non_overlap_and_scope.native_status: include/libgnss++/algorithms/observable_upstream_preprocessing.hpp explicitly omits correct_pseudorange.m base compensation; no implementation is authorized by this record
non_overlap_and_scope.accuracy: 0.782 reachability is not evaluated in Phase62; any accuracy phase requires a new immutable freeze after the raw-only gates pass
